| still flat colour | **0** |
| need no texture | 36 (slabs inherit; fluids are flat) |

Drop files into one folder and run:

```bash
node tools/textures/upload.js --dir <folder> --user <yourId> --dry
```

Either filename works — the Voxl name, or the Minecraft one (a resource pack
drops straight in). Add `_top` / `_side` / `_bottom` for per-face textures;
no suffix means the same image on every face.

## Need no texture of their own (36)

Slabs take their parent material's texture automatically, so texturing
`Quartz` also textures `Slab_Quartz` and `SlabTop_Quartz`.

- 2 × fluid — colour + material, no tile
- 34 × inherits its material's texture
